digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport outbound mutations
propositions: DC transport submits status as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of dispatching a transition, causing the status change to be rejected and ignored by Jira
Cloud transport routes status through transition_issue_by_name in acli.py but DC transport lacks this routing, creating parity drift between backends
outbound mapper emits status as workflow-state name but update_issue has no mechanism to convert it to a transition ID before calling issue.update
DC transport.update_issue must pop status from kwargs and route it through transition_issue_by_name to resolve either a transition name or destination status name to the correct transition
illegal transitions must remain non-fatal and observable as bridge alerts rather than silent failures
